sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Basic Materials / Paper & Paper Products · Indonesia. PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk manufactures and sells cultural paper, pulp, tissue, and industrial paper in Indonesia, Asia, the United States, Australia, the Middle East, Africa, and Europe. The company provides cigarette packaging board, corrugated carton box, corrugated carton sheet, folding box, ivory, triplex, duplex, food packaging board, corrugating medium, test liner, single face box, and converted food service packaging products.
